title: Apply tilemap cell palette IDs
changes: Allow a manually selected palette source to use each tilemap cell palette ID or one chosen bank, and show unavailable banks in cyan.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-tilemap-palettes-hh4zsvun checked per-cell colors, flips, unavailable banks and single-bank mode. Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-tilemap-palettes-eur-_o8ajeki compared a nonzero EUR palette ID against both source colors in Linux Chrome.
Protected Linux unit rom-data-viewer-tilemaps-docker-25_e_ybg verified byte equality between the current Docker and Python generated pages, including the tilemap view.
limitations: Graphics and palette source selection remain manual; no original game scene pairing is inferred. Windows remains deferred and the large-JSON prototype remains suspended.
